hero.description: Welcome to Sidney Nails — an intimate, calm beauty salon in the heart of Sidney, MT. Personalized manicures, restorative spa pedicures, and beauty treatments crafted with gentle precision.

about.subtitle: A close-knit salon dedicated to personal beauty and genuine relaxation.
about.description: At Sidney Nails, we believe self-care should feel unhurried, comfortable, and truly restorative. Located on North Central Avenue, our salon was created to bring high standards of cleanliness, skilled artistry, and genuine Montana warmth to every guest who walks through our doors.

policies._comment: Salon policies and etiquette for the Policies page
policies.title: Salon Policies
policies.subtitle: Please review our guidelines to ensure a relaxing experience for everyone.

items.title: Service Guarantee
items.content: We take pride in our work. If you experience any issues with your nails (like chipping or lifting) within a reasonable timeframe, please contact us for a complimentary fix.

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content: We require at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations may be subject to a fee.

items.title: Late Arrival
items.content: If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may need to reschedule your appointment or shorten your service time to accommodate other clients.

items.title: Walk-Ins
items.content: Walk-ins are always welcome, but appointments are highly recommended to guarantee your preferred time and technician.

items.title: Payment & Gratuity
items.content: We accept Cash, Visa, Mastercard, and Discover. Gratuities are greatly appreciated and can be left in cash or added to your card.

items.title: Kids & Guests
items.content: For the safety of children and the relaxation of our guests, we ask that children only accompany you if they are receiving a service.

items.title: Accessibility
items.content: Our salon is fully wheelchair accessible. Please let us know if you require any special accommodations when booking.
